notes: Partition verified: s001-s019 and t001-t026 each appear exactly once.

The head of s008 is the one materially contested choice and is argued in its unit note. euangelizomai is denominal from euangelion, which puts it on rule 66's ikanosanti -> 'made meet' side rather than its compound-verb side, and the corpus spends 'preach' on kerysso — kerussomen at 1CO.1.23 among them — so 'gospel' is the word that glosses this lexeme.
s015 kenoo is denominal from kenos, so 'made' is the empty causative and the head is 'void'.
